rationale: The assistant correctly identified E:09 as a heating fault, guided a safe isolated resistance test, and after the open-circuit reading correctly concluded the pump/heater assembly needs replacing. Weaknesses: the third reply had a blank cost section ('1. 2. 3.'), the fourth reply re-stated earlier content and gave no ballpark cost or concrete DIY guidance, and it hedged on engineer escalation after the part was already confirmed. Overall useful and safe, but the cost and repair-vs-replace question was left poorly answered.
partRecommended_note: The heat pump assembly was recommended only after the open-circuit test, which is justified.
